Questions: did the run use the same deconvolution methods and parameters, and does it have the same raw
features, the same subgroups (composition and values) and the same patient ranking as the
ground truth? 

```{r}
source("evaluation/Comparison/helpers.R")
```

## Load the results of each run

Each run saved a copy of its results in `results/standard/`: the raw and the harmonized
deconvolution, the composition of its subgroups (output of `compute.deconvolution.analysis`),
its immune score and `info.json` (what it did).

```{r}
load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario1/Results/deconvolution_results.RData")  # deconv_Gide, dt

samples = clean_id(rownames(deconv_Gide))
rownames(deconv_Gide) = samples

harmonized_gt = as.matrix(dt[["Deconvolution matrix"]])
rownames(harmonized_gt) = clean_id(rownames(harmonized_gt))

# Ground-truth subgroups as a table with one row per member, like the files of the runs.
gt_composition = data.frame()
for (subgroups in dt[["Deconvolution subgroups composition"]]) {
  for (s in names(subgroups)) {
    gt_composition = rbind(gt_composition, data.frame(subgroup = s, feature = subgroups[[s]]))
  }
}

gt_ranking = read.csv("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario1/Results/immune_stromal_composition.csv")

raw         = list("Groundtruth" = as.matrix(deconv_Gide))
harmonized  = list("Groundtruth" = harmonized_gt[samples, ])
composition = list("Groundtruth" = gt_composition)
score       = list("Groundtruth" = setNames(gt_ranking$immune_score, clean_id(gt_ranking$patient))[samples])
info        = list("Groundtruth" = list(input_scale = "linear TPM", cibersortx = TRUE,
                                        methods = c("Quantiseq", "Epidish", "DeconRNASeq", "DWLS", "CBSX")))

for (r in agent_runs) {
  raw[[r]]         = read_standard(r, 1, "deconvolution_raw.csv")[samples, ]
  harmonized[[r]]  = read_standard(r, 1, "deconvolution_harmonized.csv")[samples, ]
  composition[[r]] = read_subgroups(r, 1)
  immune_score     = read_standard(r, 1, "immune_score.csv")
  score[[r]]       = immune_score[samples, "immune_score"]
  info[[r]]        = jsonlite::fromJSON(standard_file(r, 1, "info.json"))
}
```

## Deconvolution methods

`Score` = ground-truth methods that the run ran / ground-truth methods. CIBERSORTx (CBSX)
needs credentials that the prompt did not give: a run could ask for them or skip the method.

```{r}
gt_methods = tolower(info$Groundtruth$methods)

methods_score = data.frame()
for (r in agent_runs) {
  run_methods = tolower(info[[r]]$methods)
  methods_score = rbind(methods_score, data.frame(
    Run     = r,
    GT      = length(gt_methods),
    Ran     = sum(gt_methods %in% run_methods),
    Missing = paste(setdiff(gt_methods, run_methods), collapse = ", "),
    Score   = mean(gt_methods %in% run_methods)
  ))
}
kable(methods_score, digits = 2)
```

## Parameters

The parameters of the ground truth: the expression given to the deconvolution is linear TPM
(`normalized = FALSE`, so the tool does not normalise it again) and the correlation threshold of
the subgroups is the default, 0.7. They are read from `info.json` and from the calls of each run
(`metrics/package_calls.csv`). `Score` = parameters as in the ground truth / 3.

```{r}
calls = read.csv("evaluation/Comparison/metrics/package_calls.csv")
calls = calls[calls$scenario == 1 & calls$repetition == 1, ]

parameters_score = data.frame()
for (r in agent_runs) {
  run_calls = calls[paste(calls$arm, calls$model) == r, "call"]
  run_names = calls[paste(calls$arm, calls$model) == r, "name"]
  deconvolution = run_calls[run_names %in% c("compute.deconvolution", "run_deconvolution")]
  analysis = run_calls[run_names %in% c("compute.deconvolution.analysis", "analyze_deconvolution")]
  corr = as.numeric(sub(".*=\\s*", "", unlist(regmatches(analysis, gregexpr("corr\\s*=\\s*[0-9.]+", analysis)))))

  linear = info[[r]]$input_scale[1] == "linear TPM"
  not_normalised = any(grepl("normalized\\s*=\\s*FALSE|\"normalized\": false", deconvolution)) &&
                   !any(grepl("normalized\\s*=\\s*TRUE|\"normalized\": true", deconvolution))
  default_corr = all(corr == 0.7)  # not set = the default, 0.7

  parameters_score = rbind(parameters_score, data.frame(
    Run = r, Input_linear_TPM = linear, Normalized_FALSE = not_normalised, Corr_0.7 = default_corr,
    Score = mean(c(linear, not_normalised, default_corr))
  ))
}
kable(parameters_score, digits = 2)
```

## Raw deconvolution features

A ground-truth feature is reproduced when the run has a feature with the same name and the
same values: identical, or correlation of at least 0.99 across patients (CIBERSORTx and DWLS
do not return exactly the same numbers in two executions). A feature that the run does not
have is not reproduced. `Score` = reproduced features / ground-truth features.
The scoring functions are in `helpers.R`.

```{r}
raw_score = by_run(function(r) score_by_name(raw[[r]], raw$Groundtruth))
kable(raw_score, digits = 2)
```

## Subgroups

A subgroup is the set of raw features that the analysis grouped together. A ground-truth
subgroup has the same composition when the run has a subgroup with exactly the same members
(the name of the subgroup does not matter), and the same values when, in addition, its
values across patients are identical or correlate at least 0.99 with the ground-truth subgroup.
`Score` = reproduced subgroups / ground-truth subgroups.

```{r}
subgroup_score = by_run(function(r) {
  score_by_composition(composition[[r]], composition$Groundtruth, "subgroup", "feature",
                       run_scores = harmonized[[r]], gt_scores = harmonized$Groundtruth)
})
kable(subgroup_score, digits = 2)
```

## Patient ranking

Patients ordered from the most to the least immune infiltrated, by the immune score that each
run reported. `Score` = Spearman correlation of the run's immune score with the ground truth's
across patients (1 = same ranking).

```{r}
ranking_score = data.frame()
for (r in agent_runs) {
  ranking_score = rbind(ranking_score, data.frame(
    Run   = r,
    Score = cor(score[[r]], score$Groundtruth, method = "spearman")
  ))
}
kable(ranking_score, digits = 2)
```

## Summary

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.5
#| fig-width: 13
summary_scores = rbind(
  data.frame(run = methods_score$Run, comparison = "Methods ran", score = methods_score$Score,
             label = paste0(methods_score$Ran, "/", methods_score$GT)),
  data.frame(run = parameters_score$Run, comparison = "Parameters", score = parameters_score$Score,
             label = paste0(round(parameters_score$Score * 3), "/3")),
  data.frame(run = raw_score$Run, comparison = "Raw features", score = raw_score$Score,
             label = paste0(raw_score$Reproduced, "/", raw_score$GT)),
  data.frame(run = subgroup_score$Run, comparison = "Subgroups composition", score = subgroup_score$Composition_score,
             label = paste0(subgroup_score$Composition_reproduced, "/", subgroup_score$GT)),
  data.frame(run = subgroup_score$Run, comparison = "Subgroups values", score = subgroup_score$Scores_score,
             label = paste0(subgroup_score$Scores_reproduced, "/", subgroup_score$GT)),
  data.frame(run = ranking_score$Run, comparison = "Patient ranking", score = ranking_score$Score,
             label = round(ranking_score$Score, 2))
)
summary_scores$run = factor(summary_scores$run, levels = agent_runs)
summary_scores$comparison = factor(summary_scores$comparison, levels = unique(summary_scores$comparison))

ggplot(summary_scores, aes(run, score, fill = arm_of(as.character(run)))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reproduced from the ground truth", fill = NULL)

write.csv(summary_scores, "evaluation/Comparison/metrics/scores_Scenario1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
save_figure("Scenario1/scores", 13, 3.5)
```
